Instrument.name: The Ultra Low Energy Charge Analyzer (ULECA) for the International Cometary Explorer
Instrument.description: The Ultra Low Energy Charge Analyzer was one of three sensors originally designed to analyze the solar wind characteristics for the International Sun-Earth Explorer 3 (redesignated the International Cometary Explorer for its extended mission). The ULECA sensor used energy deflection and total energy measurement to determine the charge composition of ions in the energy range 2 - 560 keV/charge.
